scope: Current local worker production dependency audit and source-only reachability review; no cloud, database, private configuration, native execution or dependency mutation.

advisory.title: Zod can exhaust memory while validating oversized constrained collections
advisory.reported_impact: Availability through memory exhaustion; advisory reports no confidentiality or integrity impact.
advisory.patch_boundary: Maintainer patch performs leading upper collection-size checks before walking elements. It does not make intentionally unbounded collections or unbounded JSON response bodies safe.

credentialed_daemon.status: Vulnerable library is loaded and used by Sandbox SDK control-plane response validators.
evidence: node_modules/@vercel/sandbox/dist/api-client/base-client.js: parse reads full response text, parses JSON, then calls validator.safeParse.
node_modules/@vercel/sandbox/dist/api-client/validators.js: response schemas include array-valued routes, sessions, sandboxes, command args and network policies without caller-side size prechecks.

Hosted configuration fixes deny-all policy, generated sandbox name, metadata tags and fixed command arguments. Uploaded media goes through private file transport; it does not supply SDK schema definitions, URLs or command arguments.
cli-config schemas contain scalar/object configuration fields; hosted OIDC uses the fixed provider token file and production mode disallows interactive auth fallback.
credentialed_daemon.assessment: No direct unauthenticated uploaded-media path to the affected array validator was found. A malformed or excessively large control-plane response can still affect the credentialed daemon's availability. This is reduced reachability, not a blanket waiver or proof of zero exploitability.

credential_free_native_vm.status: Affected packages are present in the sparse dependency image, but no direct media-parser validation use was found.
evidence: Fixed native task receives a closed environment without VERCEL or EPS_NATIVE_TRANSPORT; nativeSandboxConfiguration returns the local native path instead of importing the Sandbox SDK.
Native media/parser output is bounded private-file JSON with existing handwritten/domain validation; native tasks do not receive daemon/provider/OIDC credentials.
Native child process and VM have independent resource, filesystem, network and cleanup boundaries; actual hosted boundary proof remains separate.
credential_free_native_vm.assessment: The advisory is not a reported native decoder RCE or credential-exfiltration issue. A native VM failure remains isolated from parent credentials by the reviewed design; actual hosted isolation is still unverified.

required_before_real_media: Pin patched Zod 4.6.7 through root overrides scoped to @vercel/cli-config and @vercel/sandbox; retain current Sandbox/OIDC versions and avoid forcing Zod v4 onto unrelated v3 consumers.
Review the lockfile delta, perform the repository's frozen install, rerun the scoped production audit and focused worker/SDK compatibility tests.
Reseal the sparse source manifest and rebuild both daemon and native images. Preserve the pre-fix source graph and audit evidence; never relabel an old image as patched.
Require actual hosted credential-free boundary/cleanup proof before private media processing. The known advisory alone does not prohibit a bounded no-PII build/boundary probe.
automatic_fix_rejected_as_strategy: npm audit proposes @vercel/oidc 3.5.0 and @vercel/sandbox 3.6.1. Those downgrades would abandon required current SDK behavior; no audit fix or dependency change was executed.
